trigger: Repository and public-surface documentation contains trademark and identity-state wording that differs from the conservative canonical registry.

whys.answer: Several documents and public surfaces encode status prose independently.
The documents predate a single validated identity registry and reusable scanner.
Apple preflight previously evaluated manifest identity without consuming public-surface findings.
whys.evidence: scripts/validate-apple-distribution.py now accepts a sanitized scanner report

stop_reason: Evidence does not establish that every mismatch was public at the same time or that any statement was intentionally misleading.
immediate_correction: Classify each mismatch and block registration or clearance claims that exceed the registry.
root_cause_correction: Generate claims from canonical state where practical and require scanner plus Apple identity preflight before release.
recurrence_guard: CI validates the registry, scanner fixture, and Apple preflight; tests cover false registration and contradiction fixtures.
